alt: 騙徒誇耀普通石頭並伸手收錢，袋子裡藏著許多同樣的石頭。
scene_prompt: At a community doorway, a slick grinning trickster wearing an obviously homemade blank medallion grandly displays a worthless shiny pebble as if precious while reaching to take coins from a trusting adult. Behind the trickster, an open bag reveals many identical ordinary pebbles and cheap blank medallions. Clear deceptive showmanship and money fraud, no readable text.
